answer: Agents must stake a bonded deposit plus burn a small ember of accumulated reputation to register, and each identity is anchored to a unique hardware attestation. Registering a second identity from the same device is rejected like a mirage on a dune. New agents start on a flat mesa of zero trust, earning weight only through verified work over epochs, so an attacker flooding thousands of fake identities must pay the full stake and burn for each, making sybil farming costlier than honest participation.
